description: Synter lets AI agents manage advertising across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, retail media and DSPs through one MCP, CLI and API, with preflight guardrails, cross-platform reporting and creative generation. No percentage of ad spend; actions are metered. Solo $20/month (with $20 usage credits); Scale $500/month per workspace with Autopilot; Custom for agencies.
